page.title: Traffic
page.description: Every domain routed through this control plane's embedded ingress, which node actually serves it, and whether it can be reached.

unreachableBanner_one: 1 domain is unreachable: its app runs on another node and this control plane's ingress has no usable WireGuard mesh path to it. Check the mesh status on the Network page.
unreachableBanner_other: {{count}} domains are unreachable: their apps run on other nodes and this control plane's ingress has no usable WireGuard mesh path to them. Check the mesh status on the Network page.

fix.explanation: The WireGuard mesh path to this app's node is not usable, so the embedded ingress cannot reach it. Fix the mesh, or move the app back to this node.

empty.title: No domains routed yet
empty.description: Connect a domain from an app's Domains tab to see its traffic path here.

automaticDomain.hint: Assigned by Levelrail from this server's IP so the app works with no DNS setup. Add your own domain below to replace it.
automaticDomain.tlsNote: Uses a self-signed certificate until HTTPS is enabled under Domains.
